description.text:
Sticks'n'Sushi is restaurant, takeaway, catering and bar. We serve high-quality, fresh food based on a unique combination of traditional sushi and yakitori sticks from the grill. So for those less keen on fish, there is a selection of chicken, lamb, beef and vegetable skewers - all grilled fresh to order. The menu also offers vegetarian dishes and kids menus as well as a variety of salads and tasty delicacies.

IF YOU THROW A PARTY - INVITE US:

We promise to behave, in fact we'll do more than that. We'll bring the food, the drinks and the dessert. Everything we serve can also be ordered as catering. You call - we cook. Feel free to ask for advice about what to choose, what's good for dessert, and which drinks go best with the dishes you have chosen. 

Location: Crossrail Place
